title: seampact tree node
description: A tree node fragment: a route, a relay route, a collection or a single.

node.title: node
node.description: A tree node: a route (method), a collection (kind: collection) or a single (kind: single) (ADR 0002 section 6).

route.description: A route: settings, inherited below (ADR 0002 section 8).

path.description: Replaces the node's path segment: relative, no leading slash, may hold {param}.

pathParams.description: The schemas of the extra path placeholders.

output.description: The body of the single success response.

item.description: Instead of 'output', on a list: the schema of one record.

filteredBy.description: The right the application applies to its query.

concurrency.description: On a member route: opts into the version.

identity.description: The identity the routes below require.

scopes.description: Scopes entered here, each read from a value source.

errorRoles.description: Role bindings for this subtree, the nearest winning.

headers.description: Request headers: a fields map keyed by header name.

query.description: Query fields; on a node, they reach the safe routes below it only.

internal.description: Keeps the routes out of documents with internal: exclude.

format.description: The wire format of the routes below.

relayRoute.description: A relay route: its shape is derived from the public operation (ADR 0002 section 7).

relays.description: <api>.<operationId>: the public operation this route relays.

collection.description: A collection: settings, inherited below (ADR 0002 section 8), ops, and the collection and member scopes.

id.description: A fields map with one entry: the member id parameter and its schema.

idProperty.description: The item property holding the member id.

singular.description: The noun of member operation ids.

owner.description: caller: the caller owns the records.

ops.description: The ops shorthand: a list of list, get, create, update, delete, batch, or a mapping from op to its settings (ADR 0002 section 6).

collection.description: The collection scope: settings plus routes.

member.description: The member scope: settings plus routes.
